evals.name: generate-port-mock
evals.prompt: Configure .mockery.yaml to generate mocks for UserRepository in internal/user/domain/port.
evals.expected_output: A .mockery.yaml entry configuring mock generation with correct package and directory targets.
assertions: Target interface matches domain port name.
Configures output directory to test support or mocks folder.
Configures inpackage: false to keep production code free of mocks.

evals.name: testify-mock-expectations
evals.prompt: Write a unit test for a user registration usecase using a Mockery-generated UserRepository mock.
evals.expected_output: Unit test using On(...).Return(...) expectations and verifying with AssertExpectations.
assertions: Sets up expected method calls and return values using mock.On().Return().
Uses mock.MatchedBy or specific argument values.
Calls mock.AssertExpectations(t) to ensure all calls occurred.

evals.name: mock-package-placement
evals.prompt: Where should generated mocks live in a hexagonal Go project?
evals.expected_output: Guidance placing mocks in internal/testsupport/mocks or adapter mocks package, never in domain core.
assertions: Mocks are strictly isolated from domain core packages.
Domain core does not import testify or mock packages.
Mocks are imported only in _test.go files.
